parent_objective: design fixed-budget off-track repair panel before no-rollout preflight
blocked_by: need repair panel design before materializing repair subset

public_gates: M1720 must design a no-rollout fixed-budget repair panel before materialization
M1720 must preserve baseline and conditional-positive controls
M1720 must include the wide-relaxed-extended composite variant only if it exists in the calibration matrix
M1720 must select repair sources from M1718 target slices without using profile ranking
M1720 must not run rollout train replay PPO promote use private holdout or change actor inputs
M1720 must not claim controller-family ranking, paper-level evidence, or level3 self-ID

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs fixed-budget repair panel from localized off-track target slices
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: repair-panel design only; no rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if repair panel uses profile ranking
stop if baseline controls are omitted
stop if conditional-positive controls are omitted
stop if selected sources are not traceable to M1718 targets
stop if design routes directly to rollout
fallback_plan: route to no-rollout repair preflight if design is accepted
route to source-distribution redesign if target slices cannot produce a balanced panel
route to artifact repair if M1702 calibration matrix is missing required variants
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1719 routes localized off-track dominance to repair panel design

admission_evidence: M1719 finds M1718 localization actionable enough for repair design
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1720 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up no-rollout repair preflight manifest
next_stage_criteria: source and variant selection rules are explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; M1720 designs task repair and cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: design must keep L1, L2-current-tiled, L3-online, and L3-reset controls in the repair panel
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1718 localization and M1719 audit only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If no balanced repair panel can be designed, route to source-distribution redesign rather than weakening self-ID standards.
allowed_claims: no rollout, training, replay, PPO, private-holdout, promotion, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A fixed-budget repair panel can be designed from M1718 localized off-track targets while preserving baseline and conditional-positive controls.
success_criteria: repair panel selected base/source rule is explicit
baseline and conditional-positive controls are preserved
all twelve controller-family profiles remain controls
rollout execution training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: design uses profile ranking to select sources
environment rollout training replay PPO private holdout promotion or actor-input changes occur
decision_rule: M1720 passes if it designs a fixed-budget off-track repair panel and routes to no-rollout preflight without overclaiming.
